title: Travel
subject: English
summary: “Travel” is a poem that describes the joy and excitement of travelling to different places. It encourages us to explore the world, visit new places and learn about different people, cultures and traditions. Travelling gives us new experiences and helps us understand the beauty of nature and the world around us. It also makes our minds curious and teaches us many things beyond books. The poem teaches us that travelling is a wonderful way to learn new things, explore the world and enjoy life.
